Across her inaugural Around the World voyage in 2028,

will call on destinations spanning six continents, with overnight stays in captivating destinations such as Papeete, Bora Bora, Sydney, Bali, Tokyo, Bangkok and Mumbai. Thousands of small-group shore excursions will be available to guests to explore the local culture, cuisine and heritage of these destinations, with nearly 100 UNESCO World Heritage sites within reach across the full Around the World sailing.
Highlighted 2028 Around the World Voyage Segments aboard

17-day voyage from Miami to Los Angeles, departing January 19, 2028. Journey through the Panama Canal and along the vibrant coastlines of Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Nicaragua and Mexico, discovering a rich blend of tropical landscapes, colorful cultures and coastal cities before arriving in Los Angeles.

19-day voyage from Papeete to Sydney, departing February 23, 2028. Set sail on a South Pacific adventure and discover idyllic island destinations including Bora Bora, Pago Pago, Vava'u, Lautoka, Port Vila and Noumea before sailing onwards to Sydney.

14-day voyage from Bali to Taipei, departing March 27, 2028. Explore the diverse landscapes and cultures of Southeast Asia and Taiwan, with calls at Jakarta, Singapore, Puerto Princesa, Coron, Manila, Salomague and Hualien before concluding in Taipei.

12-day voyage from Taipei to Tokyo, departing April 10, 2028. Enjoy a visit to South Korea and an expansive exploration of Japan, with calls including Busan, Kagoshima, Nagasaki, Kochi and Osaka, combining ancient traditions, vibrant cities and rich culinary culture before concluding in Tokyo.

12-day voyage from Hong Kong to Bangkok, departing May 2, 2028. Journey through Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand, with calls including Hanoi (Ha Long Bay), Ho Chi Minh City, Sihanoukville and Ko Kood, where storied traditions meet dynamic cities, before concluding in Bangkok.

14-day voyage from Istanbul to Barcelona, departing June 20, 2028. Discover the Mediterranean's rich history and coastal beauty, visiting destinations such as Athens, Katakolon, Messina, Salerno, Rome, Florence, Pisa and Livorno, Nice, Saint-Tropez, Sète and Palamos, concluding in Barcelona.
For more information on Oceania Cruises' collection of extended global itineraries, visit OceaniaCruises.com or call 855-OCEANIA.

Oceania Cruises® is the world's leading destination- and culinary-focused luxury cruise line, celebrated for its port-rich voyages and authentic cultural and culinary experiences. The line's intimate, luxurious ships feature an adults-only environment, with a high proportion of spacious rooms and suites, calling on more than 600 marquee and boutique ports in more than 100 countries across seven continents, with destination-intensive itineraries ranging from seven to 180 days. Aboard the designer-inspired ships, guests enjoy personalized service supported by a strong crew-to-guest ratio, alongside The Finest Cuisine at Sea®, prepared by one of the highest chef-to-guest ratios at sea. Oceania Cruises® is also recognized as one of the world's most awarded cruise lines, with accolades spanning luxury, dining, service and destination experiences. Oceania Cruises® has five Sonata Class ships on order scheduled for delivery in 2027, 2029, 2032, 2035 and 2037. Oceania Cruises® is a wholly owned subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd.
